description: Frame 18 formal crop composition for the adult Xiaoqi identity edit.
composition_method: paste edited crops onto the exact base-image bounding boxes after verifying original crop coordinates
notes: Base and crop assets were generated from the frame prompt package with the Image2 CLI model alias.
Run scripts/compose_fixture_frame_crops.ps1 with ProjectSlug=liuyi-that-day, FrameId=liuyi_frame_18, and -DetectOnly before formal composition when base or crop assets change.
Stage2 must visibly diverge from the base crop, and Stage3 must preserve the edited crop exactly at the declared bbox.
Formal edits must enter through scripts/run_fixture_frame_script.ps1 and keep the project model default at gpt-image2.
